thread:
morgan p (pm): Quick sync — recruiting wave for DP v4. We need a lightweight triage rubric for incoming signals + a plan for staggered invite windows. TL;DR: propose small sample sets, top 3 signal types, and micro-incentives for low-engagers. Thoughts?

alex k (product): +1. Suggested rubric: Severity (prod-impact), Frequency (how many customers), Repro (easy/medium/hard), Priority score = severity * frequency / repro. Keep to <=3 fields so partners can fill fast.

priya s (research): Love the score calc. Add 'signal type' (bug / UX / feature-request / regression). We'll need example sample prompts for evals (n=10) to catch regressions and hallucination cases. I can whip up the prompts.

jamie r (cs): For recruitment windows — recommend 3 waves: alpha (5 partners), beta (20 partners), open (75 participants). Each wave has distinct feedback goals: alpha = deep product fit + infra, beta = workflows + UX, open = scale + perf. Incentives: alpha = $500 + 1:1, beta = $150, open = swag/credit.

sam g (eng): Engineering note: private deployment customers may not be able to share raw logs. Add a redaction checkbox and require minimal repro steps. Also we should automate triage label creation in Linear via webhook so we don't lose signals.

alex k (product): +1 on Linear automation. Can we make a 1-minute form: one-liner summary, steps to reproduce, dataset size (if applicable), screenshots, and a severity slider. Draft form link: https://www.example.com/dp-form (placeholder)

morgan p (pm): I'll own the rubric doc and canonical triage labels. Priya — can you produce the 10 eval prompts by Friday? Jamie — can you confirm incentives budget and whether we can top-up for high-value partners?

jamie r (cs): Confirmed budget up to $8k for the quarter. We can reallocate if we see high ROI or a critical partner. :moneybag: We should reserve a small discretionary pot for escalations.

priya s (research): Will deliver prompts on Friday EOD. Also propose adding 'time-to-first-complete' metric for partner quality (days between invite and first substantive response) and a 'clarity' binary flag on each feedback item.

sam g (eng): Can we add a short SDK snippet for logs redaction and an example webhook payload for Linear? Example redaction snippet: ```python
# redact example
redact_fields = ['ssn','email']
send_logs(redact=True, fields=redact_fields)
```

morgan p (pm): Nice. Also we should tag each partner's feedback item with 'signal_strength' (high / medium / low) so PMs can filter more easily during roadmap triage.

alex k (product): One more ask — make a mini-training doc for partners on what 'good' feedback looks like (5 bullets + 2 examples). I can draft the training doc and a short Loom.

jamie r (cs): Ops: schedule a 30m async check-in next Wed to confirm the first wave list and check redaction readiness. I'll start the calendar thread and a pinned checklist.

morgan p (pm): Perfect. Action items (so it's clear): Morgan = rubric doc + triage labels; Priya = 10 eval prompts; Alex = partner training doc + Linear webhook spec; Jamie = confirm budget + invite list + schedule check-in; Sam = redaction SDK snippet + Linear automation hook. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder: There is a scheduled deploy to staging tomorrow 02:00 UTC that may affect beta flows.

morgan p (pm): noted — will avoid invite sends during staging window.
